name: ekosmart-workspace
description: Ekosmart EV Battery Solution & Spare Parts - Full-Stack Enterprise Platform

scripts.assemble:dist: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist'))fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','dist',{recursive:true,force:true});if(fs.existsSync('admin-portal/dist'))fs.cpSync('admin-portal/dist','dist/admin',{recursive:true,force:true});if(fs.existsSync('employee-portal/dist'))fs.cpSync('employee-portal/dist','dist/employee',{recursive:true,force:true});if(fs.existsSync('api/.htaccess')){fs.mkdirSync('dist/api',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('api/.htaccess','dist/api/.htaccess',{force:true});}console.log('Assembled dist/ directory for cPanel deployment.');"
